creator: Karoryfer Samples
selection_note: Four representative recorded velocity layers and two recorded round robins per pad for a ten-pad acoustic kit. Original source bytes unchanged, no normalization, resampling, onset edits, or pitch variation. Sampler manifest uses four MIDI ranges 1-31,32-63,64-95,96-127. The three tom pads use different original 14,15,18 inch drums. Close microphones only (snare top). Detailed articulations and original layer counts are in kit_contract.
